# Model catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_catalog.py. Edit catalog/models.json, not this file. -->

**42 curated entries · literature sweep through 2026-08-25**

Status: **PR** = peer-reviewed · **PP** = preprint · **R** = released artifact. The tables are descriptive, not rankings.

## Genomics

Ordered DNA, variation, and sequence-to-function regulatory models.

| Model | Year | Input language | Output / translation | Scale | Artifacts |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [AlphaGenome](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-10014-0) | 2026 PR | DNA sequence up to 1 Mb | base-resolution regulatory tracks, expression and splicing predictions, and variant-effect scores | 1 Mb context; 5,930 human and 1,128 mouse genomic signals | [code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphagenome) · [weights/API](https://www.alphagenomedocs.com/) |
| [Evo 2](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10176-5) | 2026 PR | single-nucleotide DNA sequence | sequence likelihoods, embeddings, variant effects, annotations, and generated DNA | 7B and 40B parameters; 9.3T tokens; up to 1M-token context | [code](https://github.com/ArcInstitute/evo2) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/arcinstitute/evo2_7b) |
| [GET](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08391-z) | 2025 PR | accessible-region × transcription-factor motif matrices across genomic loci | regulatory activity, gene expression, regulators, and regulatory interactions | pretrained across 213 human fetal and adult cell types | [code](https://github.com/GET-Foundation) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/spaces/get-foundation/GET) |
| [GPN-MSA](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-024-02511-w) | 2025 PR | whole-genome multispecies nucleotide alignment | genome-wide variant-effect likelihoods | alignment-conditioned DNA model evaluated genome-wide | [code](https://github.com/songlab-cal/gpn) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/songlab) |
| [Nucleotide Transformer](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02523-z) | 2025 PR | tokenized DNA sequence | contextual nucleotide embeddings and task-adapted genomic predictions | 50M–2.5B parameters; 3,202 human genomes and 850 diverse species | [code](https://github.com/instadeepai/nucleotide-transformer) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/InstaDeepAI) |
| [Caduceus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03234) | 2024 PR | single-base DNA sequence with reverse-complement symmetry | bidirectional long-range DNA representations | state-space models with contexts up to 131 kb | [code](https://github.com/kuleshov-group/caduceus) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/kuleshov-group) |
| [DNABERT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15006) | 2023 PP | BPE-tokenized multi-species DNA | DNA embeddings and fine-tuned genome classification predictions | 117M parameters; benchmarked across 36 datasets and 9 tasks | [code](https://github.com/MAGICS-LAB/DNABERT_2) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/zhihan1996/DNABERT-2-117M) |

| Model | Year | Input language | Output / translation | Scale | Artifacts |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [CAPTAIN](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-72882-y) | 2026 PR | co-assayed single-cell RNA and surface-protein abundance | joint cell embeddings, expanded protein profiles, integration, and cell-communication predictions | scT&P-4M: more than 4.2M co-profiled human and mouse cells and 382 proteins | [code](https://github.com/iamjiboya/CAPTAIN) |

| [MIMIC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24506) | 2026 PP | arbitrary observed subsets of sequence, structure, regulation, evolution, and experimental context | reconstructed or generated missing biomolecular modalities | 1B-parameter generative model trained on the aligned LORE dataset | [code](https://github.com/PolymathicAI/MIMIC) · [weights/API](https://huggingface.co/polymathic-ai/MIMIC) |

## Reading the table

- A code link does not imply that model weights or outputs have an unrestricted license.
- `Input language` describes the actual computational representation, not the broad biological field name.
- `Output / translation` distinguishes embeddings, prediction, alignment, and conditional generation.
- See [selection method](docs/selection-method.md) for evidence and inclusion rules.
